metadata.title: Urban Grit Portrait with Gradient Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy urban portrait featuring a man in a flat cap and sunglasses leaning against a textured wall, overlaid with massive, vertically-stretched sans-serif typography featuring a vibrant red-to-blue vertical gradient.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject integrated behind and between large-scale foreground lettering
Warm golden-hour lighting on face contrasting with cool blue shadows
Horizontal lines of the shutter door contrasting with verticality of the type
Rough concrete and metal textures against smooth digital color gradients
coreInvariants: Grainy film texture across the entire image
Vertical red-to-blue color gradient in the display type
Subject wearing dark sunglasses reflecting the environment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, medium shot from waist up, leaning slightly to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and sunglasses serve as the primary focal point, framed by the large letters.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the vibrant top of the letters, move down to the subject's face, then follow the lean of the body toward the textured wall on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with texture and large-scale graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and charcoal grays in the subject's clothing and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre and golden tones from the lighting on the shutter and skin.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta-red and cobalt blue used exclusively for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements against a desaturated, gritty photographic background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid clean whites; use off-white or textured grays for highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Flat terminals and uniform stroke width
Tight kerning that forces interaction with the subject
Subtle stipple or airbrush texture applied to the color fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are layered both in front of and behind the subject to create depth
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant typeface paired with raw, unpolished photography.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for vertical stretching.
Offers various widths that match the tall, flat-sided aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, high-contrast 35mm film photo of a man in a flat cap and sunglasses leaning against a metal roll-up shutter door in warm evening light. The right side should feature a weathered concrete wall with faint, illegible graffiti.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, extra-condensed sans-serif word across the top. Use a vertical gradient from vibrant red at the bottom to cobalt blue at the top. Mask the letters so the subject appears to be standing inside or slightly in front of the middle characters. Add a heavy grain texture to the text fill.

verificationChecks: Does the gradient transition smoothly from red to blue?
Is there a consistent film grain across both image and text?
Does the subject overlap the typography to create depth?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
Any identifiable brand logos on clothing
Specific graffiti tags on the wall
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the sunglasses have realistic environmental reflections.
Check that the red-to-blue gradient is vertical, not horizontal.
Verify that the font weight is heavy enough to support the grain texture.
Confirm the lighting on the subject matches the lighting on the background shutter.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Stretched Gradient Type + Film Grain Overlay
